Stroke Recorder - ജയശ്രീ

Draw over each ghosted glyph to record how it is written. Each pen-down→pen-up gesture becomes one stroke. Export when done and save as js/src/stroke-data.raw.json.

Drop glyph-data.json here, or click to browse.
Located at js/src/glyph-data.json in this repo - it contains all Malayalam clusters pre-shaped from the font.

Draw over the ghost with your mouse or finger. Each gesture = one stroke, in writing order.

A "custom cluster" is any character sequence you type in that isn't already in this list - e.g. to spot-check a specific conjunct or word part. It's added with no ghost outline (nothing was pre-shaped for it from the font), so you draw it freehand.

Saved remarks export under stroke-data.raw.json's reserved _remarks key - they're for a human/agent reviewer, never consumed by the runtime composition code.

stroke-data.raw.json

Save this as js/src/stroke-data.raw.json and commit it, then run python tools/process_strokes.py --preset=malayalam to regenerate js/src/stroke-data.json, which the demo loads automatically via writer.loadStrokes().
